flags: minor: 'salient' is the only advanced-vocabulary option; test-wise students may pick it on register alone
S040-01.notes: 'First thing visitors notice' = most conspicuous. Concealed/modest contradict; temporary unsupported.

S040-02.notes: Almost all films local = narrow/provincial. Eclectic is opposite; ambitious unsupported; controversial is vague and not what the colon evidence explains.

S040-03.notes: Introduces Pando (~47,000 trunks, one root system), then grazing preventing regeneration. Facts accurate. B/C/D describe content absent from text.

S040-04.notes: Non-observers started disordered and kept less accurate distance signals -> social learning refines dance. A contradicted (they did dance and improved); B unsupported/inverted (distance was affected by lack of observation); D contradicted. Consistent with the 2023 Science honeybee social-learning study.

S040-05.notes: Claim needs both frozen (~95%, nearly all) and room temp (30%, lost most). Only B addresses both. A omits frozen; C omits room temp; D true but irrelevant.

flags: minor: D is the only choice mentioning a date at all, making the key easy to spot
S040-06.notes: Charcoal inscription dated mid-October (Oct 17) and charcoal fades quickly -> eruption after mid-October 79. Others irrelevant to the date.

flags: minor: key is notably the longest choice
S040-07.notes: 2018 U-Th dating of crusts in three Spanish caves to 64,000+ years predates modern human arrival by ~20,000 years -> Neanderthal art/symbolism, contradicting Text 1. Hedge 'if their dates are accurate' matches Text 2. Facts accurate.

S040-08.notes: Only C pairs self-taught (limited training) with major recognition (FRS 1918) using a concessive. Facts accurate (Hardy 1913, FRS 1918).

S040-09.notes: Benefits then a drawback (higher cost) -> contrast/concession. 'At the same time' is the only contrastive option; A causal, B example, C summary all wrong.

S040-10.notes: Noun needed after 'little' (mass use): 'little effect on'. 'affect' is a verb (noun sense is psychological jargon); 'little effects' ungrammatical with mass 'little'; 'affected' is verb form.
